items.title: AI memory with biological decay (52% recall)
items.raw_excerpt: Most RAG setups fail because they treat memory like a static filing cabinet. When every transient bug fix or abandoned rule is stored forever, the context window eventually chokes on noise, spiking token costs and degrading the agent's reasoning. This implementation experiments with a biological approach by using the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve to manage context as a living substrate. Memories are assigned a "strength" score where each recall reinforces the data and flattens its decay curve (spaced repetition), while unused data eventually hits a threshold and is pruned. To solve the "logical neighbor" problem where semantic search misses relevant but non-similar nodes, a graph layer is layered over the vector store. items.title: 第八届智源大会即将在6月12日-13日正式开启
items.raw_excerpt: 这一年，人工智能发展的底层逻辑正在发生改变。 热度并未退潮，而在加速前进。更重要的变化是，人工智能正在从“能力竞赛”走向“系统落地” —— 如何在真实世界中稳定运行、持续演化，并真正嵌入人类社会与产业体系。 以 智能体（Agent） 为代表的新一代系统范式正在兴起。AI不再只是生成内容的工具，而是逐步嵌入工作流，具备持续感知、决策与执行能力。从“回答问题”到“完成任务”，从单轮交互到长时序闭环，人工智能正在走向参与行动与决策的系统形态。 同时，面向物理世界的 世界模型（World model） 正加速孕育。从多模态理解到空间与动态建模，AI开始以“状态”为核心刻画现实世界的演化规律与因果机制，从“生成符号”走向“与物理世界互动”。 智能体需要更强的世界建模能力，才能在复杂环境中稳定执行；而世界模型也需要通过行动与反馈，形成闭环学习与持续优化。由此，AI发展进入一个新的阶段—— 能够在真实世界中运行的“智能系统” 。 但在能力跃迁的同时，一系列关键问题也日益凸显，包括下一代AI技术路径与未来系统形态如何构建、对齐与治理如何前置而非事后修补、智能商业闭环如何打通等等。 第八届北京智源大会将于2026年6月12日-13日在北京中关村国际创新中心重磅开启。 延续七载硬核学术基因，汇聚图灵奖得主、海内外顶尖学者与产业领袖，智源大会将在思辨与实证中，让智能真正落地生根，为下一代人工智能的发展建立更清晰的坐标系。 全球AI领袖齐聚，共绘进化蓝图 自2019年启幕，北京智源大会已经连续成功举办七届，凭借国际视野和专业深度，成为全球AI从业者不可错过的年度盛事。七年来，12位图灵奖得主、近千位顶尖专家亲临现场，吸引全球30多个国家和地区、累计超60万人次专业人士参与，成为全球AI创新的重要风向标。 2026年6月12日至13日，第八届智源大会将以“线上+线下”联动的形式于北京中关村国际创新中

excerpt_i18n.en: The underlying logic of AI development is shifting this year. The momentum has not waned but is accelerating. More importantly, AI is transitioning from a "capability competition" to "system deployment"—how to operate stably, evolve continuously, and truly embed into human society and industrial systems in the real world. A new generation of system paradigms, represented by agents, is emerging. AI is no longer just a tool for generating content but is gradually integrating into workflows, with capabilities for continuous perception, decision-making, and execution. From "answering questions" to "completing tasks," from single-turn interactions to long-sequence closed loops, AI is evolving into a system form that participates in actions and decisions. Meanwhile, world models oriented toward the physical world are accelerating development. From multimodal understanding to spatial and dynamic modeling, AI is beginning to depict the evolution laws and causal mechanisms of the real world with "states" as the core, moving from "generating symbols" to "interacting with the physical world." Agents require stronger world modeling capabilities to execute stably in complex environments, while world models need actions and feedback to form closed-loop learning and continuous optimization. Thus, AI development enters a new phase—"intelligent systems" capable of operating in the real world. However, alongside capability leaps, a series of critical issues are becoming increasingly prominent, including how to construct next-generation AI technology pathways and future system forms, how to embed alignment and governance upfront rather than as post-hoc fixes, and how to achieve intelligent business closed loops. The 8th Beijing Zhiyuan Conference will address these topics.
excerpt_i18n.es: Este año, la lógica subyacente del desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial está cambiando. El entusiasmo no se ha desvanecido, sino que se acelera. Un cambio aún más importante es que la IA está pasando de una "competencia de capacidades" a una "implementación sistémica": cómo operar de manera estable en el mundo real, evolucionar continuamente e integrarse verdaderamente en la sociedad humana y los sistemas industriales. Está surgiendo un nuevo paradigma sistémico representado por los agentes inteligentes. La IA ya no es solo una herramienta para generar contenido, sino que se integra gradualmente en los flujos de trabajo, con capacidades de percepción continua, toma de decisiones y ejecución. Desde "responder preguntas" hasta "completar tareas", desde interacciones únicas hasta ciclos cerrados de largo plazo, la inteligencia artificial avanza hacia una forma sistémica que participa en acciones y decisiones.

items.title: What type of code should you generate with AI?
items.raw_excerpt:
I (and many people) have been thinking a lot about "what are the best tasks to do using AI."
My personal framework I've been using is, you should use AI to generate code when: 1. The code is easy to validate 2. It is not important that a human understands it I find that the best thing to AI generate is something on the level of a pure function (easy to validate + not necessarily important to understand implementation as long as you understand the interface). I've tried doing things like generating whole services or applications, but those often violate rule 1 - it's hard to validate an entire application behaves "correctly" when "correctly" isn't really well defined - i.e., are there memory leaks, is it secure, is it able to be monitored, etc. I'm curious of others thoughts on this topic.

excerpt_i18n.en:
On April 21, Roewe held a grand launch event for its 20th anniversary and the new AI sequence product series, themed "The First." Roewe, in collaboration with Volcengine, officially unveiled the world's first AI-native automotive sequence, "Jiayue," and introduced the industry's first AI-native technology architecture, "CPP." The first concept car of the Jiayue sequence, the Jiayue 07, made a stunning debut, ushering in a new era of AI-native vehicles with groundbreaking technological capabilities, delivering a transformative smart mobility experience for Chinese families.  

Roewe and Volcengine have deepened their partnership to drive the automotive industry's leap from "car + AI" to "AI-native cars." As ByteDance's cloud and AI service platform, Volcengine's Doubao large model processes over 120 trillion tokens daily, firmly ranking among the global top tier. This collaboration goes beyond the industry's common "AI in the car" approach, exploring a more profound AI automotive path: through joint definition of interaction experiences and co-development of AI platforms, achieving a more proactive, deeper, and integrated cooperation model. From the initial design phase of AI automotive products, the two sides established a joint R&D project team, adhering to the core concept of "AI go first," and deeply co-developing in areas such as AI-native technology architecture, intelligent cockpits, and vehicle-cloud integration, building a shared technology foundation.  

Focusing on the construction of AI-native vehicles, Roewe has comprehensively innovated from underlying capabilities and core technologies to overall architecture, deeply integrating the AI capabilities of Volcengine's Doubao large model. This marks the first time an AI large model has been deeply embedded into a physical vehicle, enabling the scheduling, decision-making, and execution of physical devices, transforming AI from an interactive tool into a core driver of the vehicle.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 21 de abril, bajo el lema "El primero", se celebró con gran éxito el 20 aniversario de Roewe y el lanzamiento de la nueva serie de productos de IA. Roewe, en colaboración con Volcano Engine, presentó oficialmente la primera serie de automóviles nativos de IA del mundo, "Jiayue", y lanzó la primera arquitectura tecnológica nativa de IA de la industria, "CPP". El primer coche conceptual de la serie Jiayue, el Jiayue 07, hizo una impactante aparición, inaugurando una nueva era de automóviles nativos de IA con capacidades tecnológicas revolucionarias y ofreciendo a las familias chinas una experiencia de movilidad inteligente trascendental. La profunda cooperación entre Roewe y Volcano Engine impulsa la transición del automóvil de "automóvil + IA" a "automóvil nativo de IA". Como plataforma de servicios de nube e IA bajo ByteDance, el modelo Doubao de Volcano Engine tiene un volumen diario de llamadas de tokens.

Across four sessions, over a dozen top R&D and planning experts took turns explaining the AI evolution from a single grain of rice to the entire home. This was no ordinary technology briefing, but rather a deep narrative centered on "how innovation happens." A line from the "Outline for Building a Strong Intellectual Property Country" recently issued by the State Council was repeatedly cited: "Intellectual property not only protects outcomes but also organizes innovation." This statement fits Midea perfectly. While the industry was still debating whether "smart homes are a false proposition," Midea had quietly accomplished two major feats: embedding AI into over 150 categories of small appliances and building a "patent Great Wall" of over 165,000 patent applications worldwide. Yet, more intriguing than the data are the hidden details. A R&D engineer with a decade of experience in rice cooking revealed that, to ensure "perfect rice no matter how much water you add," they spent nearly 16 years since 2010 mapping the industry's first Chinese rice map. A microwave expert disclosed that a single AI vision cooking system alone has over a hundred invention patents. Meanwhile, the head of whole-home smart products bluntly stated, "The industry is all about connecting large models, but only we truly understand home appliances." This is no longer the Midea you remember as merely "making air conditioners and selling rice cookers." From the "home brain" to the "factory brain," from human-vehicle-home connectivity to humanoid robots, Midea is now driven by the dual engines of AI and patents.

Background  
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are becoming the core architecture for robotic intelligence, but existing mainstream approaches (e.g., OpenVLA, π0, CogACT) suffer from a fundamental flaw: using a single action model to handle all types of actions uniformly. This "one-size-fits-all" design exposes two inherent contradictions in robotic manipulation tasks.  

From the perspective of task characteristics, robotic manipulation involves two essentially different types of actions: large arm movements (coarse actions) require global scene understanding with loose path constraints, while fine gripper operations (fine actions) demand local precision, accurate grasping poses, and extremely low error tolerance. These two action types differ fundamentally in path constraints, visual attention, and data distribution, making it inherently conflicting for a single model to balance "coarse positioning" and "fine manipulation."  

Furthermore, traditional methods lack active perception and routing mechanisms for action types, failing to dynamically allocate appropriate reasoning resources based on the current manipulation stage. This leads to a rapid accumulation of errors as steps increase in long-horizon complex tasks. DAM-VLA (Dynamic Action Model-Based Vision-Language-Action) is the first to decouple arm movement and gripper operation modeling, incorporating a dual-scale weighting mechanism to achieve precise and efficient robotic manipulation.

Este diseño de «talla única» revela dos contradicciones internas al enfrentarse a tareas de manipulación robótica. Desde la perspectiva de las características de las tareas, la manipulación robótica implica dos tipos de acciones esencialmente diferentes: los movimientos amplios del brazo (acciones gruesas) requieren comprensión global de la escena y restricciones de trayectoria laxas; las operaciones finas de la pinza (acciones precisas) requieren un enfoque local detallado, posturas de agarre exactas y un margen de error extremadamente bajo.

excerpt_i18n.en:
On April 27, Tencent QClaw announced a major version upgrade. The new version (V0.2.14) is the first to support the Hermes framework, allowing users to create Hermes Agents and achieve "shrimp and horse farming" within a single application. The underlying model of QClaw has also been upgraded to support free switching, integrating the latest Hy 3 preview and DeepSeek-V4 Pro. Meanwhile, QClaw has completed multiple capability and experience upgrades: the "Inspiration Square" has been fully upgraded to "Expert Square," with over 100 AI experts newly added, enabling every user to access professional-grade Agent capabilities with zero barriers; a new WeChat Mini Program has been launched, featuring voice interaction, file sharing with friends, and other functions; the connector has added platforms such as Baidu Netdisk, Ctrip, and Fliggy; and the Agent team collaboration feature based on Tencent Docs has also been launched simultaneously.  

The "Inspiration Square" has been upgraded to "Expert Square," with over 100 AI experts now available. As the highlight of this upgrade, QClaw has fully transformed the original "Inspiration Square" into "Expert Square," launching over 100 AI experts covering various industries such as content creation, data analysis, and code development. In the original Inspiration Square, QClaw addressed the question of "what AI can do" by showcasing various use cases to inspire users. However, after extensive research, QClaw found that for novice users unfamiliar with AI tools, there remains a barrier to entry.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 27 de abril, Tencent QClaw anunció una gran actualización de versión. La nueva versión (V0.2.14) es la primera en ser compatible con el framework Hermes, permitiendo a los usuarios crear un Hermes Agent para lograr "criar gambas y caballos" en una misma aplicación. El modelo subyacente de QClaw también se ha actualizado para permitir el cambio libre, e integra las últimas versiones Hy 3 preview y DeepSeek-V4 Pro. Al mismo tiempo, QClaw ha completado múltiples mejoras de capacidad y experiencia: la "Plaza de Inspiración" se ha actualizado completamente a "Plaza de Expertos", añadiendo más de 100 expertos en IA, para que cada usuario pueda acceder a capacidades de Agent de nivel profesional sin barreras.
